page_title: STU 1-0 HEI | Stuttgart v Heidenheim 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90+4' Stuttgart are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+2' After what seems an eternity, referee Tobias Stieler decides there was a foul after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL, play to continue.
90+2' Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90+2' What a goal that is! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Diant Ramaj and into the net. 1:0.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch for Bilal El Khannouss.
90' Substitution. Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) has come on for Jamie Leweling.
89' Here is a change. Arijon Ibrahimovic is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Adam Kolle (Heidenheim).
89' Substitution. Tobias Weigel (Heidenheim) in, Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen out.
89' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
87' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
85' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
84' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
83' A cross from Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
82' Stuttgart keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
81' A nice individual effort by Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
80' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Julian Niehues will be replaced by Yannik Wagner (Heidenheim).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) replaces Luca Kerber.
79' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
77' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
76' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is replacing Niklas Dorsch.
74' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
71' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:1.
68' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) attempts to feed Luca Kerber with a chip pass, but Alexander Nubel reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
68' Tobias Stieler has a clear sight and sees a foul from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart).
68' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

65' 1 - 0 Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
65' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box.
62' Stuttgart fail to score from a corner as Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.

61' What a great effort! Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
59' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
58' The game is interrupted as Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is flagged offside.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) for Atakan Karazor.
57' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Badredine Bouanani is replaced by Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart).
56' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Luca Jaquez.
55' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
53' A pass from Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by Diant Ramaj and the move breaks down.
51' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
48' Luca Jaquez (VfB Stuttgart) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
47' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but Diant Ramaj punches the ball away.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
44' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Stieler had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Tobias Stieler couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) and blew his whistle.
41' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
39' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
37' Stuttgart players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
36' Dangerous play by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart). Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Diant Ramaj.
29' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
28' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Some neat passing and movement from Heidenheim as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
23' Fine play by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
23' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' Diant Ramaj displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
20' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the left side of the goal, but Alexander Nubel keeps it out with an amazing save.
16' Tobias Stieler blows for a foul after Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
14' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
6' Stuttgart are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
4' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' Rough tackle by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' The Heidenheim players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
